programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape

programme.title: Forensic Files: Knot for Everyone

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ghost in the Machine

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1999, 27-year-old Michelle Despinasse was shot dead in her Nanuet, NY home. Her answering machine captured her final moments, her voice pleading "Ken, stop", and became key evidence that convicted her ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 16-year-old calls 911 claiming an intruder killed her mom and her mom's boyfriend. But bloody footprints and security footage told a very different story. A true crime case built on lies that unraveled fast.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: En iCarly-fan, Valerie, inviterer Freddie på en date. Daten går så godt, at Freddie begynder at filme Valeries eget webshow. Men Freddie føler sig splittet, da Valeries webshow skaber problemer for iCarly-webshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunstneriske kvaler
programme.desc: Carly inviterer Spencers kunsthelt, Harry Joyner, til at kigge på Spencers kunstværker. Da Harry kalder Spencers kunst for amatøragtigt, føler Spencer, at hans liv ikke længere giver mening.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarlys største fan
programme.desc: iCarlys største fan, Mandy, inviteres til at se en livesending af iCarly. Men Mandy viser sig at være mere stalker end fan, så de må gøre alt for at slippe af med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Rugemor
programme.desc: Carly og Sam forsøger at udklække kyllinger i et naturvidenskabsprojekt. Men æggene klækker tidligere end forventet, og pludselig er der kyllinger overalt i lejligheden! Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer må finde kyllingerne i lejligheden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg gider ikke slås
programme.desc: Carly laver en en unik iCarly T-shirt til Sam for at markere årsdagen for deres venskab. Men da Sam bytter den for koncertbilletter, bliver de to venner uvenner.

programme.title: iCarly: Dansegal
programme.desc: iCarly beder sine fans om at sende videoer ind af dem dem selv, når de danser deres sejeste danse. Over tre tusind danseklip kommer ind, og Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at holde sig vågne hele natten for at se dem.

programme.desc: Nogle vaskebjørne stjæler Beavis og Butt-Heads nachos, og drengene kæmper tilbage./ Beavis forveksler en fremmed med Butt-Head og kan ikke slippe af med ham.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Black Ice News
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn, der glæder sig over fordelene ved deres nu lovlige ægteskab, en politibetjent, der møder sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' bliver forfulgt af en superfan.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama Shutdown
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver lidt for høj, en fodboldspiller, der vil gøre alt for at få det røde kort, og to sexeksperter, der giver råd om cunnilingus.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Airplane Showdown
programme.desc: En steward skal håndtere en passager, som ikke vil spænde selen, britiske opdagelsesrejsende diskuterer deres rejser, to par forsøger at undgå spoilers på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe oplever en guddommelig intervention.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End
programme.desc: Ray Parker Jr. har nogle nye sange, en mand kan ikke lade være med at sige 'deez nuts', Keegan må ringe til 112 og en ung mand lærer om Negrotown.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass

programme.desc: Som den mindst forudindtagede mand i kabel-tv lover Daniel at bringe folk sammen for at grine i valget 2016.

programme.desc: Daniel fejrer Jesu fødsel, blokerer sine mest irriterende Twitter-følgere og giver seerne en cremet godbid, så de kan huske ham.

programme.title: The Roast of Charlie Sheen

programme.desc: Adam og Andi gør sig store anstrengelser for at sikre et lån til at løse et uventet problem på det hus, som de har tænkt sig at istandsætte og videresælge.

programme.title: Man with a plan

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.desc: A man murders his estranged wife's lover after confronting the couple in an Edmonton parking lot.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast

programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 21. december
programme.desc: Hvis Julemand 39 skal undgå at blive degraderet til nisse, skal han have helt afgørende oplysninger af Julemand 68, som er på vej hjem fra Bahamas.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 22. december
programme.desc: Nu har julemand 39 samlet en vifte af oplysninger, der kan belyse mysteriet om den julefjendske familien Andersen. Putte er nisse - halvt nisse i hvert fald, og hun vil giftes med helnissen Frits, som på det groveste har drevet gæk med familien Andersen

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 23. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har lovet Julemandsrådet at forklare brik for brik alt om mysteriet om den forsvundne juleaften hos familien Andersen.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 24. december
programme.desc: I 23 dage har Julemand 39 nu efterforsket sandheden om hin juleaften for 19 år siden hos familien Andersen. Sammen med sin assistent, Frits, har han afsløret detalje på detalje, og han troede, at nu havde han fundet sandheden

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 1. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har ikke passet sit job som julemand tilfredsstillende, derfor kræver Julemandsrådet, at han skal gå op til reeksamen.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 2. december
programme.desc: Julemandsrådet har bestemt, at Julemand 39 skal op til julemandseksamen igen. Skæbnen vil, at han får familien Andersen, den vanskeligste opgave

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 3. december
programme.desc: Hvis Julemand 39 ikke kan få familien Andersen til at holde jul, er han ikke længere julemand. Men 39 har en plan

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 4. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 er i overhængende fare for at blive degraderet til nisse. Heldigvis er det lykkedes ham at få anbragt sin assistent, Frits, hos familien Andersen.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 5. december
programme.desc: Frits er vel ankommet til familien Andersens hjem. Han er allerede håbløst forelsket i datteren Putte, men det lykkes ham dog alligevel at finde et vigtigt spor i sagen - en musetrappe, som han tager med tilbage til Julemand 39.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 6. december
programme.desc: For at undgå degradering til nisse, må Julemand 39 få den julefjendske familien Andersen til at fejre jul i år. Hans assistent, Frits, har fundet et spor i sagen - en musetrappe - men han har også forelsket sig stormende i husets datter Putte.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 7. december
programme.desc: Det er en særdeles vanskelig opgave Julemand 39 har fået af Julemandsrådet. Nu ved han ikke en gang, om det et 19 eller 20 år siden, familien sidst holdt jul.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 8. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har kun 17 dage tilbage til at afsløre familien Andersens hemmelighed og få Tage, Åse og Putte til at hengive sig til juleriet. Han har stadig ingen spor at gå efter.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 9. december
programme.desc: Julemandsrådet er ved at miste tålmodigheden med Julemand 39. I endnu et forsøg på at løse gåden om Andersens julefjendskhed har 39 sendt Frits ned til familien forklædt som Åse Andersens lillebror, onkel Klavs fra Australien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 10. december
programme.desc: Den intetanende familien Andersen har taget godt imod Frits, der er forklædt som Åses bror Klavs fra Australien. Familien har det godt - bortset fra Putte, som savner sin gas- og vandmester.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 11. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor har familien Andersen ikke fejret jul i 19 år - eller er det 20? Skal svaret findes i kælderen? Julemand 39’s assistent, Frits, opdager, at Tage Andersen - efter at familien er gået til ro - lister ned i kælderen og låser døren efter sig.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 12. december
programme.desc: Hvor mange hemmeligheder har familien Andersen egentlig? Julemand 39’s opgave bliver vanskeligere og vanskeligere. Moster Karen har hemmeligheder for hele familien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 13. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor vil familien Andersen ikke fejre jul? Julemand 39 har nu kun 11 dage tilbage til at løse mysteriet, ellers degraderer Julemandsrådet ham til nisse. Julemand 39 har bedt Notarius om at hjælpe sig med at finde Julemand 68

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 14. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har endnu ikke fundet afgørende spor i efterforskningen af familien Andersens julehemmelig­hed. Og der er nogen, der har fjernet vigtige oplys­nin­ger i juleannalerne.

programme.desc: Da en tidligere marinesoldat mistænkes for at have lavet en kemisk bombe, der blev fundet i et køretøj, vender Nate Getz tilbage til Los Angeles. Holdet må nu samarbejde med FBI for at forfølge og fange en indenlandsk terrorist.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: NCIS tror, at de har fundet en russisk celle midt i forstaden og får derfor Kensi og Derek til at gå undercover som et gift par.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: Relive the bravery of the Dunkirk veterans in defenseless boats crossing the English Channel to rescue the stranded soldiers through their uplifting stories of heroism in a battle that changed the course of WWII.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A pastor's pregnant wife is shot during a home invasion while he's at the gym. Police cleared him fast, but the public wasn't convinced. A solved true crime case full of suspicion, conspiracy theories, and heartbreak.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A beloved teacher is stabbed to death in her own classroom by a 15-year-old student who warned classmates about his plan. No one believed him. A solved true crime case that is shocking, deeply disturbing, and a devastating loss for an entire community.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named
programme.desc: In November of 1973 female skeletal remains were found in a creek in Colorado. Her identity was restored after 51 years but authorities are still asking the public for help piecing together her story.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1991, 19-year-old aspiring actress Heather Stigliano was beaten and stabbed to death in her Myrtle Beach apartment during a robbery. James Whipple was caught weeks later and confessed, saying he killed her for drug money.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Suzanne Eaton, a renowned American scientist, vanished while jogging on the Greek island of Crete. The investigation into her murder uncovered a killer hiding in plain sight. A solved true crime case you won't forget.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?
programme.desc: On July 8, 1980, Andrew and Joyce Manchester returned from vacation to discover their 26-year-old daughter Anne had been missing for 10 days. She vanished without a trace and was never seen again.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A woman stalks and kills her estranged husband's new girlfriend in broad daylight while witnesses watch. She tried to cover it up, but the evidence was overwhelming. A solved true crime case that is vicious, obsessive, and heartbreakingly avoidable.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.
